Description: Encoding-model results for the facedetection task over 108 images (Figure 3, Supplementary Figure 4, Supplementary Tables). Every array except images has one entry per predictor, in the order of features.

features.Description: Predictor names, in the order of every other array: FaceExpect, Pixel, Crowding, Clutter_rms, FaceSize, FaceEcc, BodySize, BodyEcc, SceneFaceDet, UntrainedCNN.

images.Description: Indices of the 108 analysed images into data/stimulus_order.tsv (column image_index).

single_preview.Description: Single-feature predictivity of a model with this predictor alone. Predictivity: signed squared Spearman correlation, sign(r) * r^2, between predicted and observed held-out values of the per-image mean log detection latency (log of the geometric mean across participants), averaged over the 100 folds of 50 balanced repeated two-fold splits over images, divided by the split-half reliability of the condition (config.RELIABILITY). Condition: preview.

unique_preview.Description: Unique predictivity: predictivity of the full 9-predictor model minus that of the same model without this predictor. Predictivity: signed squared Spearman correlation, sign(r) * r^2, between predicted and observed held-out values of the per-image mean log detection latency (log of the geometric mean across participants), averaged over the 100 folds of 50 balanced repeated two-fold splits over images, divided by the split-half reliability of the condition (config.RELIABILITY). Condition: preview. NaN for UntrainedCNN, which is not in the full model.

single_sd_preview.Description: Standard deviation of the value across the 100 cross-validation folds. Folds overlap, so this is descriptive and is not used for inference. For single_preview.

unique_sd_preview.Description: Standard deviation of the value across the 100 cross-validation folds. Folds overlap, so this is descriptive and is not used for inference. For unique_preview.

p_single_preview.Description: One-sided permutation p for predictivity > 0: latencies shuffled across images and the whole cross-validation rerun, 5000 permutations, p = (1 + #null >= observed) / (1 + 5000). For single_preview.

p_unique_preview.Description: One-sided permutation p for predictivity > 0: latencies shuffled across images and the whole cross-validation rerun, 5000 permutations, p = (1 + #null >= observed) / (1 + 5000). For unique_preview. NaN for UntrainedCNN.

single_no_preview.Description: Single-feature predictivity of a model with this predictor alone. Predictivity: signed squared Spearman correlation, sign(r) * r^2, between predicted and observed held-out values of the per-image mean log detection latency (log of the geometric mean across participants), averaged over the 100 folds of 50 balanced repeated two-fold splits over images, divided by the split-half reliability of the condition (config.RELIABILITY). Condition: no-preview.

unique_no_preview.Description: Unique predictivity: predictivity of the full 9-predictor model minus that of the same model without this predictor. Predictivity: signed squared Spearman correlation, sign(r) * r^2, between predicted and observed held-out values of the per-image mean log detection latency (log of the geometric mean across participants), averaged over the 100 folds of 50 balanced repeated two-fold splits over images, divided by the split-half reliability of the condition (config.RELIABILITY). Condition: no-preview. NaN for UntrainedCNN, which is not in the full model.

single_sd_no_preview.Description: Standard deviation of the value across the 100 cross-validation folds. Folds overlap, so this is descriptive and is not used for inference. For single_no_preview.

unique_sd_no_preview.Description: Standard deviation of the value across the 100 cross-validation folds. Folds overlap, so this is descriptive and is not used for inference. For unique_no_preview.

p_single_no_preview.Description: One-sided permutation p for predictivity > 0: latencies shuffled across images and the whole cross-validation rerun, 5000 permutations, p = (1 + #null >= observed) / (1 + 5000). For single_no_preview.

p_unique_no_preview.Description: One-sided permutation p for predictivity > 0: latencies shuffled across images and the whole cross-validation rerun, 5000 permutations, p = (1 + #null >= observed) / (1 + 5000). For unique_no_preview. NaN for UntrainedCNN.

p_delta_single.Description: Two-sided permutation p for delta_single: the two condition means are exchanged for a random subset of images and the cross-validation rerun, 5000 permutations; the null is recentred to remove the offset that the two different reliabilities place on it.

p_delta_unique.Description: Two-sided permutation p for delta_unique: the two condition means are exchanged for a random subset of images and the cross-validation rerun, 5000 permutations; the null is recentred to remove the offset that the two different reliabilities place on it.

beta_single_preview.Description: Standardised regression coefficient of the single-feature model, mean across folds; predictor and dependent variable z-scored within each training fold. Negative means faster detection. Not noise-corrected. Condition: preview.

beta_single_sd_preview.Description: Standard deviation of the value across the 100 cross-validation folds. Folds overlap, so this is descriptive and is not used for inference. For beta_single_preview.

beta_full_preview.Description: Standardised regression coefficient in the full 9-predictor model, mean across folds, standardised as beta_single_preview. NaN for UntrainedCNN. Condition: preview.

beta_full_sd_preview.Description: Standard deviation of the value across the 100 cross-validation folds. Folds overlap, so this is descriptive and is not used for inference. For beta_full_preview.

beta_single_no_preview.Description: Standardised regression coefficient of the single-feature model, mean across folds; predictor and dependent variable z-scored within each training fold. Negative means faster detection. Not noise-corrected. Condition: no-preview.

beta_single_sd_no_preview.Description: Standard deviation of the value across the 100 cross-validation folds. Folds overlap, so this is descriptive and is not used for inference. For beta_single_no_preview.

beta_full_no_preview.Description: Standardised regression coefficient in the full 9-predictor model, mean across folds, standardised as beta_single_no_preview. NaN for UntrainedCNN. Condition: no-preview.

beta_full_sd_no_preview.Description: Standard deviation of the value across the 100 cross-validation folds. Folds overlap, so this is descriptive and is not used for inference. For beta_full_no_preview.
